topic: Connectors: let Claude read your calendar and email to prep your meetings
post:
Tired of copy-pasting emails into AI? 📋
You don't have to. Claude can connect to the apps you already use.

They're called connectors.
A connector is a secure link between Claude and an app like Gmail, Google Calendar or Google Drive, so Claude can look things up for you.

How to turn one on:

1️⃣ In a chat, click the "+" button and choose "Connectors" → "Manage connectors"
2️⃣ Pick an app and click "Connect"
3️⃣ Sign in, then switch it on for your conversation

Try this on a Friday afternoon:
"Look at my calendar for Monday. For each meeting, find related emails from this week and give me a 3-line prep note: what it's about, what's open, and what I should bring."

Good to know 🔐
✅ Claude only sees what YOU already have access to
✅ For actions like sending email, it asks for your approval by default
✅ Connectors work in regular chats and in Cowork, even on the free plan
(On Team and Enterprise plans, an admin turns them on first.)

Why it matters:
The biggest time sink with AI is moving information into it. Connectors bring the information to Claude, so you can skip straight to the thinking. 💡

Which app would you connect first? 👇

Follow me: I'm teaching one Claude skill a day, no tech background needed.
